I couldn't find anything in the FastAPI docs about deploying a Flask app or about AWS Lambda. These docs cover FastAPI apps only, so for Flask you'd want to check Flask's own documentation or AWS's Lambda guides.

If you're working with a FastAPI app instead, the docs say FastAPI is open source and based on standards. You can deploy FastAPI apps to any cloud provider you choose.[1] They advise you to follow your cloud provider's guides to deploy FastAPI apps with them.[1] The docs I found don't include Lambda-specific steps. More on deployment: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/deployment/fastapicloud/
